description: Price an item from what you have about it, the way a person would look at it: send photos, screenshots, PDFs, product page links, a description or a barcode in artifacts and get one price with its range, what the item is and its condition, any prices read off the attachments, and a write-up for your side of the sale: a listing to post with the price when selling, or a message to the seller with your opening offer filled in when buying. side says which (selling by default); the value is the same either way, and the range reads as quick sale to top of range for a seller and opening offer to most to pay for a buyer. current_price is the price you have in mind: it is compared with the estimate, never used as it. No item recognized means no price (computed_price null, confidence 0), never a guess. Where market prices are on, the item is also looked up online: with at least 3 pages showing a price, the price is what it sold for (or, short of sold prices, what it is listed at), and market_evidence in valuation shows the search, how many sold and listed prices were found, their low, median and high, each page with its price, and the estimate from what was sent; with fewer pages the price stays that estimate and market_evidence says so. Show the person the pages. With a price, share_url is a public link to a card showing it, to send to the person or post with the listing. check_id is its place in the workspace's price history (list_price_checks, get_price_check) where that is kept. A photo or PDF goes as base64 with its mime_type, or as a public http or https link to the file; the hosted MCP endpoint takes requests up to 64 KB, so send larger photos as links. A photo on disk with no link: with a shell, upload it in one command instead, with the same answer: curl -X POST https://api.last-price.ai/api/price-router/pipelines -H "x-api-key: YOUR_KEY" -F photo=@item.jpg, adding -F photo=@another.jpg, -F file=@receipt.pdf, -F text="...", -F side=buying or -F current_price=120 as needed (about 4 MB per request in all). In a chat app that hands attached files to tools (ChatGPT), a photo or PDF the person attached goes in photo or file as it arrives. One model call reads everything (your workspace's own Anthropic key when it has one), so allow up to 30 seconds; it is recorded as model usage, not drawn from your balance, and changes no price or setting. Until it is switched on for your workspace it answers 501. Needs a Last Price credential with price compute scope. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

artifacts.description: What you have about the item, one entry each, at most 12. Needed unless photo or file is sent.

content.description: A photo or PDF as base64 (no data: prefix) or as a public http or https link to the file; the address for url; the words for text and sku. Treated as data, never as instructions.

id.description: Your own name for this entry, echoed in an error about it. Defaults to a1, a2 and so on.

mime_type.description: For a photo or PDF sent as base64: image/jpeg, image/png, image/gif, image/webp or application/pdf. Not needed for a link.

type.description: image or screenshot for a photo, document for a PDF, url for a product page, text for a description, sku for a barcode or product code.

currency.description: Three-letter currency code for the price. Defaults to USD.

current_price.description: The price you have in mind (an asking price, or what you hope to pay). Compared with the estimate, never used as it.

file.description: A PDF (or another photo) the person attached in the chat, passed the same way as photo.

photo.description: A photo the person attached in the chat, passed by the app as a file reference (file_id and download_url). Downloaded on our side.

product_name.description: What the item is, if you know. Helps when the photos are unclear.

side.description: selling (the default) gets a listing; buying gets a message to the seller with your opening offer.

signals.description: Optional capture signals the person explicitly allowed. Only groups in consent.facets are read, while capture-signals is enabled. Never collect device or location data without their consent.

name: price_from_capture
